title: Commercial overview: timelines in every tile, click through to the records

items.summary: Every tile now has a small bar chart showing the number over the chosen period. New filter "Frequency" (Auto, Daily, Weekly, Monthly) sets how the period is split.
items.details: Auto picks days for periods up to three weeks, weeks up to about six months, months beyond that.

items.summary: Every tile is clickable: a panel opens with a larger chart and the records behind the number (companies, calls, meetings, deals, tickets ...). Click a bar to see only that day, week or month.
items.details: Lists show the latest 300 records and link to the detailed page. Deals, companies and tickets link to HubSpot.

items.summary: Outreach emails are stacked by sequence, with emails sent and new recipients per sequence in the list. LinkedIn actions now include connection requests and follows besides messages, stacked by type.
items.details: LinkedIn actions used to count messages only, so the number is higher than before. Instantly is shown as one block because Instantly reports per day, not per campaign and day.

items.summary: Responses are now counted like on the Responses page and stacked by type: connected call, email reply, LinkedIn reply.
items.details: Before, this tile showed contacts set to lead status Responded. The number therefore changed.

title: Customer details: product data is back, layout fixed

items.summary: Fix: the customer detail panel showed no usage, containers, logins or features. The data was in the database but the dashboard was not allowed to read it.
items.details: Affected everything that comes from the product database (DCP): usage against the contract, container setup, login heatmap, consent rate, feature list. All views the dashboard uses were re-checked the way a browser reads them.

items.summary: Fix: the ticket list in the customer detail was stretched over the whole screen; the licence timeline text was distorted on wide screens and its legend showed the wrong colours.

title: Filters stay as you set them, and can be saved

items.summary: Filters now stay the way you left them: period, owner, status, search and the drop-downs on individual charts are remembered per page until you change them.
items.details: This is remembered in your browser, so a different computer or browser starts with the defaults. "Reset this page to its default filters" in the Saved filters menu clears it.

items.summary: New "Saved filters" button at the top right (next to Feedback): name the current filter combination and get it back with one click.
items.details: Tick "Share with everyone" when saving and the filter appears for all users in the section "Shared with everyone", below their own filters. Periods are saved as chosen, so "Last quarter" keeps meaning the last quarter. Not on Quote checker, Professional services and the personal page.

title: Every page is now a real v2 page

items.summary: All 13 pages that were embedded from the old dashboard are now proper v2 pages: Leads, Full funnel, Email outreach, Responses, Calls, Discoveries, Journeys, Deals, Quote checker, Customers, Renewals, Tickets, Professional services.
items.details: Each page shows only its own content. Full funnel is just the funnel (stage cards and conversion), Leads is the trend, matrix and company list. They read from the JENTIS database like the rest of v2.

items.summary: One filter bar, same place on every page: period first, then the page's filters, search on the right.
items.details: The period picker is identical everywhere and always offers This quarter and Last quarter plus custom dates. Your choice is remembered per page. Professional services keeps its own planning horizon controls.

items.summary: New "?" next to every metric, chart and table: click it to see where the data comes from and how it is calculated.
items.details: The explanation names the source system (HubSpot, Instantly, La Growth Machine, Jira ...), the counting rule and when it was last refreshed.

items.summary: Fix: "Connected calls" on the overviews counted nothing for some outcomes. It now uses the same rule as the Calls page (connected + connected-but-rejected).
Fix: "Needs attention" on the CS overview and the personal page now uses the same rule as the Customers page.

title: v2 now runs on our own database

items.summary: All v2 pages read from the new JENTIS-hosted database instead of Supabase. Numbers are identical.
items.details: The data is copied from the current dashboard's database every morning at 07:40, after the nightly syncs. So v2 shows the same numbers as v1, as of that morning. Raw message texts and internal sync tables are no longer reachable from the browser.

items.summary: Menu redesigned: one consistent line-icon set, no department colours, quieter labels.
items.details: Your name and initials sit at the top (Hello … / My page). Pages that still open the current dashboard show a small v1 ↗ on hover; pages that aren't built yet are dimmed. New pages get a small orange dot instead of a badge. Environment and build moved to the bottom of the menu, next to the light/dark switch.

title: Department colours, personal page, Sales & CS overviews, celebration boards

items.summary: New personal page "Hello {name}" at the top of the menu with configurable cards.
items.details: Cards: open tasks, upcoming renewals, upcoming meetings, warnings, calls, discoveries, wins, tickets, goals, change notes, celebrations. The gear opens settings (name, global timeframe, per-card timeframe toggle). Edit mode lets you drag to reorder, resize S/M/L, add cards (the same card more than once) and remove, then save. Everything is stored in your browser for now; it moves to the user profile once login exists.

items.summary: Full funnel added under Commercial overview (shown from v1 until ported).
Sales overview: qualified accounts, opportunities, deals created, won, open pipeline by stage, Ø deal size, recent wins — with owner filter.
Customer Success overview: customers & MRR, signed, renewals due/won, upsell, PS sold, tickets; renewals due and customers needing attention.
Celebration board for Sales: qualified, new opportunity, new customer, record contract value, closed within a quarter, best quarter.
Celebration board for Customer Success: PS sold, renewals, expansions, tickets closed record, largest customer.
Menu: each department has its own colour and starts with its overview; light orange replaces the dark orange.
New commercial overview: key numbers per department with the standard period filter.
items.details: Marketing, Business Development, Sales pipeline and Customer Success each get a row of tiles; every tile compares the chosen period with the one before. The period filter (Custom… first, then week/month/quarter/year presets) is the same control on every page.

items.summary: Change notes moved to their own page with short summaries and expandable details.
The former overview (goals, this week, trends) is now the Marketing overview.
Business Development overview with an SDR filter (calls, connected calls, discoveries per person).
Celebration board: records and goals reached by the BD team, computed from calls and discoveries.
Feedback button on every page — bug, question, idea → Slack, with page and name.
items.details: Click “✎ Feedback” top right. The message goes to the reporting Slack channel together with the topic, the page you were on and your name.

items.summary: Colours aligned with the JENTIS brand kit (main blue, light blue, orange); official logo in the sidebar.
New sidebar navigation along the commercial journey; v1 pages linked until ported.
Change notes with unread badges per section and page; theme toggle (light/dark).
